propositions: git fetch against the GitHub mirror intermittently hangs past 300s wall-clock timeout because curl has no throughput-keyed abort mechanism configured
A byte-starved connection (zero bytes sent after accept) should abort in ~10 seconds via lowSpeedLimit and lowSpeedTime config, not burn the 300s budget
A legitimately slow but progressing fetch (e.g. 2000 B/s dribble) must not be aborted; the abort is keyed on throughput floor, not wall time
Transient low-speed aborts should be retried a bounded number of times in-process to self-heal within a single review, whereas non-throughput failures (auth, bad ref) must not be retried
git-subprocess plumbing must move from repo_snapshot.py to a new git_fetch.py module to respect the 800 LOC module-size cap
